LONG DESCRIPTION: The CQS compact cylinder is available for those small bore cylinder applications where saving space is a concern. While sharing many of the outstanding features of the CQ2 series, the CQS offers standard long strokes (up to 300mm) in four bore sizes from 12 to 25mm. Description: SMC MTS16-75 AIR CYLINDER incl VAT Contact us for lead time.  Min Order 1 The MTS cylinder provides superior non-rotating accuracy and linear stability in a compact package.  Traditional non-rotating cylinders typically can only hold position  to within 0.5° and have inherent sealing problems. Mounting can be done  from four precisely machined faces with parallelism of less than 0.1mm.

Title: SMC MTS25-150 AIR CYLINDER incl VAT
Description: SMC MTS25-150 AIR CYLINDER incl VAT Contact us for lead time.  Min Order 1 The MTS cylinder provides superior non-rotating accuracy and linear stability in a compact package.  Traditional non-rotating cylinders typically can only hold position  to within 0.5° and have inherent sealing problems.   Integrating a ball spline as the rod bearing, this cylinder approximates the non-rotational accuracy of a guided cylinder without the added space requirements of external guide rods. In addition, a special rod seal design limits leakage to the  equivalent of a round piston rod seal.  An optional end lock retains the rod in the retracted position even in the event of loss of air pressure for added safety.  Mounting can be done  from four precisely machined faces with parallelism of less than 0.1mm.

Title: SMC EX510-GPR1 00140820 Incl VAT
Description:
Brand: SMC
PART NUMBER: EX510-GPR1
DESCRIPTION: EX510-GW, Gateway System Unit
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Communication Protocol: PR1 (PROFIBUS-DP)
LONG DESCRIPTION: With increased industry requests for smaller gateway serial interface units using less wiring and offering easier installation, development engineers from SMC, the world´s leading automation control experts, could not resist the call. The result of their endeavours can now be seen with the launch of their latest decentralised gateway type Serial Transmission System – Series EX510. Designed for use across a broad range of applications, the EX510 is ideal for processing both input and output commands from a PLC across a field bus network. Benefits of its decentralised design include a reduction of system wiring and PLC size, when compared to similar parallel type wired systems, and the fact that I/O units can be placed up to 20 metres away from the gateway unit to get even closer to the application. Compatible with CC-Link, DeviceNet and Profibus network protocols, the Series EX510 gateway unit can also accommodate up to 64 inputs and 64 outputs. Additional design features include the provision of 4 input and 4 output branches which effectively means that it's possible to connect several distributed valves and sensors including pressure, flow and auto switches to one gateway unit.Series EX510 has also been designed with ease of installation in mind, so all the units can be DIN rail mounted and include press fit connectors that don´t require the connecting wire to be stripped. Further time saving benefits can also be made as the EX510 is also available with pre-wired and mounted manifold units using SMC´s popular SY, SYJ or VQZ valve ranges.
BULLET POINTS: Compatible with the following network protocols: CC-Link, DeviceNet, PROFIBUS. Maximum of 128 points. A total of 4 input branches and 4 output branches per gateway unit. No special tools required for installing cables. Cable lengths of up to 20 metres from the gateway unit are possible. Gateway unit is suitable for mounting inside a cabinet.
